name: Yellow duck figurine

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Magic action: throw it to a spot within 60 ft: it comes alive for up to 12 hours as a small creature that serves you (it uses a Raven's statistics), then can't be used again for 2 days.

summary: A cheerful yellow bath toy that comes alive as a small servant for up to 12 hours (once every 2 days).
text: Found by a claw-footed tub, this bath toy looks harmless and smells of old soap. Hurled at a spot within 60 feet with a Magic action, it comes alive and serves you as a small creature with a Raven's statistics, knowing your languages and doing as you say, for up to 12 hours or until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points or you touch it and use a Magic action to end it. Afterwards it needs 2 days before it works again.
